about: What step 5's fuzzing of the desktop's readers kept (PLAN-E2E-CLIENTES.md, «Lo que el paso 5 revisa»): inputs of another device or of the server, each with the desktop's answer, hand-picked ones first. desktop-electrobun's src/mainview/src/lib/e2e/fuzz-corpus.test.ts holds the desktop to it, and the mobile app's fuzz task holds its own readers to the same answers: where they differ, the two engines separate. Bytes are standard base64; null is a reader's refusal. Written by fuzz.test.ts with DUVET_FUZZ_CORPUS=write; `seeds` a real core made.

readers.cbor: cbor(bytes) reads a value (read) or refuses (null)
readers.event_entries: the entry an event carries (entryOf; a DM_MESSAGE_CREATE's, messageEntry): {id, entry, generation?}, or null
